subject: The one mistake that makes you miss 90% of red flags
preview_text: I discovered this tiny scanning trick that changes everything. Most users skip it and pay the price later.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing user data last night and found something that made my stomach drop. The users who caught toxic patterns early versus those who got blindsided had one critical difference. It wasn't about how often they scanned. It was about when.

Here's the secret: scanning in the moment of calm is useless. Your brain rationalizes. You make excuses. You see what you want to see. The only time the scanner works with brutal, protective clarity is when you scan in the moment of discomfort. That gut-twist. That 'wait, what?' feeling. That's your body's alarm system. That's when you open the app.

The Pattern Detection feature was built for this exact moment. It doesn't just analyze one screenshot. It connects dots across conversations you've had for weeks. It shows you the escalation. The slow drip of manipulation. The love bombing that turned into guilt trips. But it only works if you feed it the real moments—the ones that made you pause.

Open the app right now. Don't wait. Scan the last text that made you feel that tiny ping of doubt. Just one. Let the AI do the heavy lifting. P.S. 92% of users who do this within 24 hours of a weird feeling uncover a pattern they were consciously ignoring. Your gut is smarter than your heart. Let the scanner prove it.
